name: civicfix-pakistan
description: CivicFix Pakistan — civic issue reporting app with token rewards, for Android (Play Store) via Capacitor.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
